headline: Icon, a Texas company that 3D-prints buildings with robotic systems, has raised $200 million to build and deploy more of its Titan machines.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: large round for construction robotics, but no new machine action is shown.
importance_line: Home buyers and builders may see faster, cheaper construction if it works, but the savings are Icon's own claims.
summary: AI Insider reports, citing Icon, that the Austin company, which builds homes and military buildings with large 3D-printing robots, raised $200 million in a Series D round co-led by Baillie Gifford and funds managed by BlackRock. Icon says its Titan system can cut an average home's build time by six weeks and its cost by 40%, claims that come from the company, and plans to use the money to build more machines and open a research centre in Austin.
notes: Funding round, so machine_action is false even though the company makes robotic construction machines.
